label: Bevy (Rust)
summary: Bevy 0.20 (Rust 1.97.1+), ECS, cargo test with headless Apps, headless smoke via MinimalPlugins
setup_step: install Rust with rustup (https://rustup.rs; Windows also needs Visual Studio Build Tools, C++ workload), then: python tools/dev.py check   # the first build compiles Bevy, about 5 to 15 minutes

adopt_hints.Cargo.toml: dev.py needs a [[bin]] (or the package name) that accepts --smoke N and prints BOOT_OK; keep the [profile.dev] opt-level lines for usable debug builds.
adopt_hints.src/main.rs: dev.py smoke runs `cargo run -- --smoke N [-- game options]` and expects BOOT_OK in the output. See docs/ENGINE_FLOW.md > Adopting an existing project.
